mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, status, owner, owner_user_id, target_branch, note, dev_at, test_at, merge_at, released_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.workspace_id, b.name, b.status, b.owner, b.owner_user_id, b.target_branch, b.note, b.dev_at, b.test_at, b.merge_at, b.released_at, b.sort_order, b.created_at, b.updated_at, COALESCE(tc.task_count, 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(tc.done_count, 0) AS done_count FROM dev_branch b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND branch_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY branch_id ) tc ON tc.branch_id = b.id WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(b.status, 'dev', 'testing', 'merging', 'released'), b.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch (id, workspace_id, name, status, owner, owner_user_id, target_branch, note, dev_at, test_at, merge_at, released_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{targetBranch}, #{note}, #{devAt}, #{testAt}, #{mergeAt}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET name = #{name}, owner = #{owner}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, target_branch = #{targetBranch}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() , dev_at = COALESCE(dev_at, NOW()) , test_at = COALESCE(test_at, NOW()) , merge_at = COALESCE(merge_at, NOW()) , released_at = COALESCE(released_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dev_branch WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch_log (id, workspace_id, branch_id, action, from_status, to_status, detail, actor_name, actor_user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{branchId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, #{actorName}, #{actorUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, branch_id, action, from_status, to_status, detail, actor_name, actor_user_id, created_at FROM dev_branch_log WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200
